# Codex hook schema fixtures

These input and output schemas are copied from OpenAI Codex commit `f79b26ccbb3116b052544666a181012fb45dc49b` (release tag `rust-v0.166.0-alpha.5.1`). The upstream files are in [`codex-rs/hooks/schema/generated`](https://github.com/openai/codex/tree/f79b26ccbb3116b052544666a181012fb45dc49b/codex-rs/hooks/schema/generated). `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` are copied from the same commit. The repository is licensed under [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/f79b26ccbb3116b052544666a181012fb45dc49b/LICENSE).

Tests validate synthetic offline hook payloads and emitted responses against these pinned schemas. These fixtures are test-only and are not included in the packaged integration.
